name: agent-master-skills
description: Skills for AI coding agents — composable, disciplined, evidence-based. 32 skills across engineering, frontend, security, orchestration, and more.

plugins.name: agent-master-skills
plugins.description: Full skill library for AI coding agents — dev-craft, ui-craft, verification gates, parallel orchestration, and more.

skills.name: dev-craft
skills.description: Use for non-trivial coding work - building or changing features, fixing bugs, refactors and cleanup, migrations, schema/API/UI changes, architecture choices, reviewing a diff or PR comments, resuming

skills.name: ui-craft
skills.description: Run the 10-phase frontend development pipeline with persistent `.ui-craft` state.

skills.name: product-thinking
skills.description: Transform vague ideas into structured product specifications through 4-round refinement.

skills.name: project-discovery
skills.description: Ingest existing specifications (xlsx/csv/md/pdf) into a domain model.

skills.name: grilling
skills.description: Adversarial stress-test of plans and designs. Outputs risk register with mitigations.

skills.name: api-design
skills.description: Use when designing a new API surface or changing an existing one — choosing REST vs GraphQL vs gRPC, versioning strategy, auth/rate-limiting shape, and the contract-first flow (OpenAPI/GraphQL spec, g

skills.name: testing-strategies
skills.description: Use when deciding WHAT kind of test to write for a change — unit vs integration vs e2e vs contract vs property-based, and what failure mode each test covers.

skills.name: documentation-engineering
skills.description: ADRs, API docs, docs-as-code pipelines, technical writing.

skills.name: devops-automation
skills.description: CI/CD, IaC (Terraform), Kubernetes, progressive delivery, secrets.

skills.name: observability-engineering
skills.description: Structured logging, metrics (RED/USE), distributed tracing, SLOs, alerting.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Use before saying "done", "fixed" or "complete" on work done outside dev-craft, or when proof must outlive the session (CI handoff, release, audit) via the hash-chained evidence ledger.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.description: 8-axis code review protocol with confidence-based filtering.

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.description: Use when the cause of a bug, failing test, build break, 500 or unexpected behavior is not yet known: reproduce, form and test hypotheses, find the root cause before any fix, then prevent regression.

skills.name: bug-hunting
skills.description: Deep security vulnerability discovery: Recon, Scan, Test, Exploit, Disclose.

skills.name: image-to-design-spec
skills.description: Screenshot to design tokens, layout detection, design system generation.

skills.name: playwright-skill
skills.description: Browser testing, screenshots, forms, responsive design, UX validation.

skills.name: tdd-seam
skills.description: Use when deciding where a new test attaches (a public seam, not internals) and running red-green-refactor in vertical slices; write the failing test first.

skills.name: performance-profiler-and-tuner
skills.description: Bottleneck analysis, memory leak detection, query optimization, profiling.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.description: Use when a session is long or near its context limit, when handing work to another agent or a later session (write a handoff doc), when resuming earlier work, or when pruning stale context.

skills.name: prompt-optimizer
skills.description: Turn rough prompts into finished, ready-to-send prompts optimized for LLMs.

skills.name: retro
skills.description: Weekly engineering retrospective with git analysis and trend tracking.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Run independent tasks simultaneously using subagents.

skills.name: eval-harness
skills.description: Golden regression of skills with pass@k metrics and code/model/human graders.

skills.name: ship
skills.description: One-command automated release: test, review, version, changelog, PR.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills for the library.

skills.name: accessibility
skills.description: Use when designing, implementing, or auditing inclusive digital products for AI agents and LLM-powered applications.

skills.name: agent-architecture-audit
skills.description: Use when auditing agent or LLM applications for wrapper regression, memory pollution, tool discipline failures, hidden repair loops, or rendering corruption.

skills.name: caveman
skills.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy.

skills.name: caveman-commit
skills.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only.

skills.name: caveman-compress
skills.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup.

skills.name: fe-visual-loop
skills.description: Show-before-build visual loop for any UI-visible task.

skills.name: tech-advisor
skills.description: Use when you need to research and propose technology improvements, framework upgrades, or better alternatives for a project.
